subject: Decision-maker outreach & procurement roadmap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@novusai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: platform fit & next steps (procurement + decisioning)

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can move toward a PO if the leadership team agrees: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: conversational support for research workflows (500k tokens/day steady, spikes to 1.2M/month).
- Top decision criteria: latency SLO for interactive flows (<=200ms p95 for short queries), predictable unit economics, and SOC 2/compliance posture.
- Timeline: exploratory POC in Dec, procurement/contract in Jan if POC meets SLA/cost targets.

Suggested next steps
1) Procurement: I'll send our procurement checklist + standard enterprise terms for your legal/procurement review. Could you confirm the procurement lead and preferred process (SOW then PO, or PO then SOW)?
2) Economic buyer: can you introduce the budget owner (who signs off on capacity or approves the PO)? You mentioned a VP-level owner — we want to make sure we address ROI and cost-savings for them.
3) Security artifacts: happy to share SOC 2, infra diagrams, and a short security summary. Please confirm which artifacts your security team needs first.

Attachments: redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf (procurement overview + typical timelines)

Would you be able to loop in Lisa (procurement) and/or Maya (budget owner) so we can schedule a short 30-min alignment next week? If you prefer, we can do an internal pre-demo with your procurement/security stakeholders first.

Thanks — I’ll be on travel Thu–Fri but available via calendar for quick slots.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@novusai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novusai.com, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novusai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: platform fit & next steps (procurement + decisioning)

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap and thanks for the materials you sent during the demo. Short answers:
- Procurement lead: Lisa Tran (cc’d) is our procurement owner — she handles vendor contracts and the PO process.
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Maya R., VP Data & AI (I've copied her in the field above) is the decision owner for platform spend. She prefers a short ROI-oriented overview + a one-page cost model.
- Security asks: our security team typically wants SOC 2 Type II, network diagram, and a data flow summary for PII-scope decisions.

We can do a 30-min alignment next Tue (Nov 24) or Wed (Nov 25) afternoon PT. Please propose 2 slots and include Lisa and Maya.

Attaching our signed NDA for completeness: nova-nda-signed.pdf

Also: procurement usually prefers: 1) SOW + draft terms reviewed by legal, 2) PO issued after exec sign-off. If you can provide a short one-page SOW template and estimated monthly committed spend, that will speed approvals.

Cheers,
Ethan Shaw
Head of Platform Partnerships
NovusAI
ethan.shaw@novusai.com

To: procurement@novusai.com, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novusai.com>, Maya R. <maya.r@novusai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + proposed next steps (SOW draft + security artifacts)

Hi Lisa / Maya / Procurement team —

Thanks Ethan for the intro. Quick note to align logistics and share the artifacts you requested. Looping in Sean (account lead) and Laura (solutions) so they’re visible to procurement/legal.

Attached from our side: redwood-enterprise-terms-v1.docx (encloses standard terms + commercial sheet), redwood-security-summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope, infra diagram, data handling notes). We can also provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA or secure link if needed.

What we need from you to move forward:
- Confirm procurement process: does NovusAI prefer a redlines pass on the SOW first or negotiated commercial terms first?
- Can Maya or a delegate join a 30-min ROI + cost model review? We'll format that as a one-page cost/benefit summary tailored to your query volumes.
- Any specific contract clauses we should highlight (data residency, indemnity caps, audit rights)?

Proposed meeting times (PT): Tue 2026-11-24 11:00-11:30, Wed 2026-11-25 14:00-14:30. If those don't work, suggest two windows and we’ll accommodate.

Next steps from Redwood once we confirm process:
- Deliver a one-page ROI summary and a short SOW draft by EOD Monday (Nov 22).
- Provide SOC 2 full report via secure link when procurement/security confirm NDA.
- Schedule the 30-min alignment with budget owner to walk through cost model and SLOs.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving this along.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
